title: Protection warrior: taunts a mob off the healer and off a DPS player within 5 s

rules.desc: A mob that hits the healer (extra1) or the DPS player gets a Taunt from the Protection warrior within 5 s, at least 70 percent of the time (one trigger per mob per 12 s: Taunt has a 10 s cooldown)
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:115-117 (lose aggro -> taunt, ACTION_INTERRUPT + 1), :26 (taunt -> battle shout taunt), :61-63 (defensive stance row); ai/playerbot/strategy/triggers/GenericTriggers.cpp:289-320 (LoseAggroTrigger); ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:3986-4007 (IsTank, forced role first)
rules.why_expect: LoseAggroTrigger is active when the bot has no aggro on its current target and that target's victim is a player who is not a tank (GenericTriggers.cpp:299-316). The player is forced to dps (PlayerbotAI.cpp:3988-3990) and the priest is a healer, so every mob on either of them fires the row at INTERRUPT+1, above every DPS row. Taunt needs Defensive Stance, which the HIGH+2 stance row keeps. Expected PASS on TortoiseBots 2fdf7da8c

rules.desc: At most 30 percent of all mob damage lands on the healer or the DPS player (the rest on the tank)
rules.why_expect: an outcome, not a single row: the player opens every mob (the runner pulls with the player), so each mob lands a few hits on him before the taunt, and the priest's heal threat can pull a fresh mob. No baseline yet; the first before-run sets the number

rules.desc: The Protection warrior holds Defensive Stance (aura 71) for at least 85 percent of its in-combat samples
rules.source: ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/ProtectionWarriorStrategy.cpp:61-63 (defensive stance row, ACTION_HIGH + 2), :203-208 (overpower dance leaves it briefly); ai/playerbot/strategy/warrior/WarriorTriggers.h:8 (DefensiveStanceTrigger)
rules.why_expect: the standalone stance row returns the bot to Defensive Stance on the next tick; only the overpower dance leaves it, for one swap and back

rules.desc: Precondition: Battle Stance (aura 2457) stays on the player through the fight, so the role read by the bot is the one this trial is about
rules.source: precondition, no bot code: the stance is read by ai/playerbot/AiFactory.cpp:446-471 (GetPlayerRoles) unless the forced role decides first (ai/playerbot/PlayerbotAI.cpp:3986-3990)
rules.why_expect: setup check player_stance proves the stance at the start; the runner's threat cast every 6 s keeps the player in the stance's rotation
